category_title: Students who misbehave due to learning frustration
scenario_title: Frustration and misbehavior during difficult academic tasks when help is unavailable
minimal_context: The student is working on completing an SG diary reflection about a recent test in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please fill out the next page in your SG diary reflecting on how you handled the test today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't really like this work. If I've gubbed up doing a test or something, I probably know I could have done better, but writing this is too hard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read the prompts and do your best to answer them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know what to write. Sometimes I try to behave then something would happen and I'd not care any more. I need help with this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I need to check on the other students right now, just keep working on it by yourself.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the diary away) I get frustrated when I don't get help when I need it! If I don't really like the work or it's too hard, I'll just carry on and then get into trouble.
